title: Rebuild Kiwi's onboarding and video-KYC flow
problem: New users never get past eligibility and KYC, and they leave the lowest ratings in the whole study.
evidence: Onboarding & KYC is only 4.3% of Kiwi's reviews but 24.6% of its 1★ reviews — its #1 pain point.
Those reviews average 1.63★, 2.74 below Kiwi's overall average: the biggest rating drag of any app-theme pair analysed.
Reviews that mention KYC (n=32) average 1.34★; users cite failed video-KYC, 'eligible' screens that flip to 'not eligible' after download, and repeated rejections.

quotes.text: pathetic on-boarding process. not able to go to video kyc process. even your WhatsApp chatbot is not helpful.
browser show i am eligible but I am download the app now the show don't eligible.

title: Fix failed-payment resolution: status tracker, auto-refund ETA, human escalation
problem: When money is debited and the payment fails, users are left with no status, no refund date and no one to contact.
evidence: Payment failures are 18.1% of Google Pay's 1★ reviews and 13.4% of PhonePe's.
Customer-support reviews average 1.53★ (Paytm), 1.77★ (Google Pay) and 2.02★ (PhonePe) — rating drags of −2.5, −1.8 and −2.1, the steepest of any complaint type.
The recurring story: debited, not credited, no refund after days, and a helpline or chatbot that repeats the same lines.

quotes.text: The money was deducted from the sender's account, but I did not receive it. There is no proper update or quick support.
They don't provide contact number… The AI assistant remain repeating the same 3-4 lines.

title: Stabilise cold start and replace blunt device-integrity blocks with graceful fallbacks
problem: App slowness, crashes and security warnings that lock out legitimate users are the single biggest source of 1★ reviews at the two largest challengers.
evidence: App performance & UX is the top pain at Google Pay (25.9% of 1★) and Paytm (25.6%), and #2 at PhonePe (17.2%).
At Paytm, 55 sampled reviews about 'device environment not correct' / rooted-device warnings average 1.51★ — users report being locked out of a working app.
Google Pay reviews call out slow startup after the app has been in the background, and layouts that shift under the user's tap.

quotes.text: the app is not opening suddenly it is showing device environment is not correct.
App startup time is very long… it will take too much time to open for payment.
